findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:64 defines `Submodule.image_span_subset`, exactly reducing membership for an image of a span to membership of its generators.
findings.fix: Apply `Submodule.image_span_subset` (or `LinearMap.map_span_le`) to `(M.map p).hom`; prove only that each generator maps to the generator indexed by `q.comp p`.
findings.issue: `pathSpan.map_mem` manually performs `Submodule.span_induction` to prove that a linear map carries a span into another submodule.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:856 provides `LinearMap.ker_toSpanSingleton`; the same file’s `LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton` construction at line 891 uses that theorem and `range_toSpanSingleton` for precisely this map.
findings.fix: After removing the source `eqToHom`, use `LinearMap.ker_toSpanSingleton hx` for injectivity and `LinearMap.range_toSpanSingleton` together with `hspan` for surjectivity.
findings.issue: The pointwise-isomorphism proof manually establishes injectivity and surjectivity of `LinearMap.toSpanSingleton`, duplicating its existing kernel and range API.

summary: Two proof blocks rederive existing Mathlib span infrastructure instead of using it.
